# Button 424 (frame-range scale): frames 0..300 of chain8 in swing600.pmm by
# 1.5 with all three key kinds, then frames 0..600 of morph4 by 0.5 with
# morph keys only.
load pmm swing600.pmm
select model chain8
scale range 0 300 1.5 on on on
save pmm scaled-chain8.pmm
select all bone
select all display
save vmd scaled-chain8.vmd
select model morph4
scale range 0 600 0.5 off on off
save pmm scaled-morph4.pmm
select all morph
save vmd scaled-morph4.vmd
